title: Speaking — Using free time
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on using free time.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
How do you usually spend a free hour?
Do you prefer having plans or deciding at the last minute?

part2.topic: Describe a time you used unexpected free time especially well.
part2.closing: and explain why you would make a similar choice in the future.

questions: What determines how much control people have over their leisure time?
Can leisure activities lose their appeal if people try to make them too productive?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to using free time?
